[[File:Gadde.jpg|thumb|right|The Gadde complex]]
'''Gadde''' was built by the [[Lant Mining Corporation]] to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Lish V]]. It was an eight-sided facility that was supported by ten [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines.
